margherita.definition: An Italian pizza traditionally topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and fresh basil, it is closely associated with Neapolitan pizza culture.

pepperoni.definition: A pork and beef sausage (or a thin slice of this sausage).

hawaiian.definition: Of or relating to or characteristic of the state or island of Hawaii or to the people or culture or language.

veggie.definition: Edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant.

meat-lovers.definition: A pizza style topped with several kinds of cooked meat, such as sausage or other meat toppings.
meat-lovers.exampleUsage: The menu lists a meat-lovers pizza among the specialty options.

four-cheese.definition: A pizza or dish made with a blend of four different cheeses.
four-cheese.exampleUsage: The four-cheese pizza uses several cheese varieties.

bbq-chicken.definition: A pizza style topped with cooked chicken and barbecue-flavored sauce.
bbq-chicken.exampleUsage: The menu includes a BBQ-chicken pizza.

mushroom.definition: A living organism with a cap and stem, often found in soil.

supreme.definition: Final or last in your life or progress.

calzone.definition: A folded baked pizza-style dish made from dough enclosing cheese and other fillings.
calzone.exampleUsage: The calzone was baked until the crust was golden.

olive.definition: Small ovoid fruit of the European olive tree.

onion.definition: A strong-smelling vegetable with layers used in cooking.

sausage.definition: Highly seasoned minced meat stuffed in casings.

pineapple.definition: A tropical American plant bearing a large fleshy edible fruit with a terminal tuft of stiff leaves.

anchovy.definition: Tiny fishes usually canned or salted.
anchovy.exampleUsage: The anchovy was identified during the lesson.

dough.definition: A flour mixture stiff enough to knead or roll.

sauce.definition: To add zest or flavor to, make more interesting.

pizza-stone.definition: A flat heat-resistant stone or ceramic surface used in an oven to provide strong, even heat under pizza or bread.
pizza-stone.exampleUsage: The pizza stone stays inside the oven during baking.

pizza-peel.definition: A flat long-handled tool used by trained kitchen workers to move pizza into or out of an oven.
pizza-peel.exampleUsage: The pizza peel hung beside the oven.

timer.definition: A device that measures or signals the end of baking time.

slice.definition: A serving that has been cut from a larger portion.

napkin.definition: A small piece of table linen that is used to wipe the mouth and to cover the lap in order to protect clothing.

shaker.definition: A person who wields power and influence.

garlic-bread.definition: Slices of French or Italian bread are coated with garlic butter and baked until their edges become crisp.

dipping-sauce.definition: A sauce served separately so pieces of food can be dipped into it.
dipping-sauce.exampleUsage: The order came with a small cup of dipping sauce.

soda.definition: A sodium salt of carbonic acid.

salad.definition: Food mixtures either arranged on a plate or tossed and served with a moist dressing.

menu.definition: A list of commands or choices in a program.

brick-oven.definition: An oven built mainly from brick or masonry that stores and radiates heat for baking.
brick-oven.exampleUsage: The pizza shop uses a brick oven.

pizza-cutter.definition: A kitchen tool, often with a rolling circular blade, used to cut pizza into portions.
pizza-cutter.exampleUsage: The pizza cutter was stored safely after use.

mixer.definition: Club soda or fruit juice used to mix with alcohol.

prep-table.definition: A worktable used in a kitchen for preparing and organizing ingredients.
prep-table.exampleUsage: The vegetables were arranged on the prep table.

warming-rack.definition: A rack or heated holding area used to keep prepared food warm for a limited time.
warming-rack.exampleUsage: Prepared boxes waited briefly on the warming rack.

register.definition: A cashbox with an adding machine to register transactions.

counter.definition: Table consisting of a horizontal surface over which business is transacted.

booth.definition: A table (in a restaurant or bar) surrounded by two high-backed benches.

table.definition: A set of data arranged in rows and columns.

sign.definition: A board showing rules or information.

delivery-bag.definition: An insulated bag used to help keep food at a suitable temperature during delivery.
delivery-bag.exampleUsage: The pizza box was placed in the delivery bag.

delivery-bike.definition: A bicycle used by a delivery worker to transport small orders.
delivery-bike.exampleUsage: The delivery bike had a secure insulated carrier.

ticket.definition: A printed or electronic pass that allows entry to a ride or park.
